system.description:
Your conduct or moods are modified. This may be due to conditioning and reprogramming via time-accelerated psychosurgery drugs, genetic tweaks, psi, or other factors. This may have been a deliberate choice or it may have been inflicted against your will.

Work with your GM to define a specific emotion (e.g., happiness, contentment, love) or behavior (e.g., aggression, commitment, curiosity, orderliness, loyalty). 

Apply a –10 modifier per level to all actions when withheld from the behavior/emotion.

Level 2: You are driven to engage in the specified behavior; emotions are exaggerated. Holding back requires a WIL Check.

This trait may be taken more than once for different behaviors.
